description: A major research laboratory announces a breakthrough in automated interpretation of neural network activations, enabling real-time explanation of high-level reasoning in models above capability 50. The technique is immediately open-sourced and begins to be integrated into evaluation pipelines across multiple frontier labs, raising hopes for narrowing the safety-capability gap. This is the first such result that generalises beyond toy models.

In the autumn of 2026 an intrusion is discovered across electricity transmission operators on three continents, together with a large container port authority and a regional water utility. Two of the affected grid operators are in EU member states, but the deepest access is elsewhere, and no jurisdiction is the evident target. The intruders had been present for weeks. They were found by accident, during an unrelated audit, and the defenders' own retrospectives concede that existing detection would not have caught them.
